description: Source code for the Type 1 Glyph Loader component of the FreeType font rendering library, including functions for parsing glyphs, computing maximum advance width, and loading glyphs with scaling and hinting options.

methods.name: T1_Parse_Glyph_And_Get_Char_String
methods.description: Parses a glyph and retrieves its character string data, handling incremental font data if applicable.

methods.name: T1_Parse_Glyph
methods.description: Parses a glyph by its index, utilizing the glyph data retrieval function.

methods.name: T1_Compute_Max_Advance
methods.description: Computes the maximum advance width among all glyphs in a font face.

methods.name: T1_Get_Advances
methods.description: Retrieves the advance widths for a range of glyphs.

methods.name: T1_Load_Glyph
methods.description: Loads a glyph into a glyph slot, applying scaling, hinting, and transformations.
